pins.note: Zion-Mt. Carmel Tunnel, west portal. 1.1 mi / 5,613 ft long, completed 1930. Vehicles >11'4" tall or >7'10" wide need an escort to drive down the centerline (no two-way traffic). Bicycles and pedestrians prohibited.
Zion-Mt. Carmel Tunnel, east portal — opens directly onto the Pine Creek Bridge.
Short Tunnel (rock-spur tunnel), west portal. ~150 ft through a sandstone fin just east of the main tunnel.

segments.note: Zion-Mt. Carmel Tunnel (long). Approximate alignment between portals; the actual bore curves along the Pine Creek canyon wall.
Short rock-spur tunnel (Zion-Mt. Carmel Highway, just east of the main tunnel).
